correctness.rationale: Theorem 4.3 of Olberding–Walker gives a submersion on the whole quadrangle manifold, including both endpoints. The critical line u=0 has positive rank-one Hessian (in the w=1 chart the normal coefficient is 2/(1+4v^2), and in v=1 it is 2/(w^2+4)); the complementary chart u=1 has precisely one stationary point with Hessian diag(-8,-2). A submersion pulls back the Hessian bilinear form at a critical point, and its kernel is the preimage of the base Hessian kernel. Theorem 3.6 gives the principal-bundle projection: in a local product trivialization s is independent of the group coordinates, so removing those tangent directions preserves cleanness, normal rank and signature. Both aspect levels are nonempty (Theorem 5.4).
residual_risks: The bounded symbolic replay tests form-space derivatives only, not the geometric inputs or global topology. The numerical entries of the form-space Hessian are coordinates, not canonical metric eigenvalues on quadrangle moduli.

evidence: For a unit column x on G(3,1) and F(x)=x^TBx, the published formulas give 2(I-xx^T)Bx as gradient and 2 δ^T(B−λI)ε on x-perpendicular when Bx=λx.
For B=diag(1,0,0), at λ=0 the kernel is ker B intersect x-perpendicular and the sole transverse direction is positive; at λ=1 the whole two-dimensional normal is negative.
broader_coverage.reasoning: This general formula includes repeated eigenspaces, and gives precisely their tangent kernels and the full signatures. Both pullback and descent follow by the same local product argument for submersions, already supplied by the quadrangle paper.

originality.rationale: The exact name Morse–Bott is not needed in the prior source. The frozen normal ranks, signs and critical sets are a direct specialization of the published Grassmann Rayleigh-quotient gradient/Hessian to the rank-one orthogonal projector on RP^2, with only an invertible source-coordinate change and submersion pullback/descent. Olberding–Walker supply all the geometry used and already give the two endpoint loci, their codimensions even on the quotient, and the lack of other critical points. No independent geometric claim remains outside that combination.
residual_risks: Whether earlier quadrangle-specific text already names this Morse–Bott consequence was not established. The implication does not depend on an earlier occurrence of that name.
